target_customer: US adults with psoriasis or atopic eczema paying out of pocket for dermatologist plans and topical products
problem: Patients wait months to see a dermatologist and rely on legacy over the counter products; Northwind offered an online skin test, a dermatologist plan within hours and monthly shipped treatment.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth plus own-brand compounded Rx and OTC products, with a monthly plan; consults billed at about 40 dollars
product_category: teledermatology and direct to consumer skincare for chronic skin conditions

founders.name: Johannes Vermandois
previous_startups: Built the largest psoriasis app in Sweden over two years (Beauty Independent, Oct 2022)
founders.background_notes: Launch post: started Northwind after 20 years of severe psoriasis. YC page lists him as a former founder; bio points to a games company at tesana.com.

competitors.name: Apostrophe
competitors.what: Teledermatology service matching patients with dermatologists and shipping prescriptions, focused on acne
competitors.traction_then: Acquired by Hims and Hers, announced June 2021
competitors.funding_then: 6 million dollar seed at the end of 2019 led by SignalFire; bought for a reported 190 million dollars

competitors.name: Ro (Ro Derm)
competitors.what: Telehealth company that launched Ro Derm in February 2022
competitors.funding_then: 150 million dollar raise reported with the launch

technical_complexity.rationale: A photo upload, questionnaire and clinician workflow app is standard engineering; the harder parts were pharmacy fulfilment, compounded formulas and state by state telehealth compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Condition focus and patient data on psoriasis outcomes helped, but larger telehealth players such as Ro and Hims and Hers could add psoriasis and eczema programs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hims and Hers had already bought Apostrophe in 2021, and Ro launched Ro Derm in February 2022; no source shows a direct copy of the psoriasis niche.

market_need_then: The launch post states the company's own claims that the average dermatologist wait is 4 months and 15,000 people signed up before launch, in 47 states. Funding into other teledermatology companies in 2021 and 2022 showed investor interest.

branding.domain_note: Used northwindskin.com rather than northwind.com; the site now returns a page that only says Hello World.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.visual_style: Swedish designed and American made formulas positioned as vegan and dermatologically tested (company claim)
identity.voice_and_tone: Personal founder story: 20 years of severe psoriasis

branding.brand_signature: Founder with psoriasis story and a Swedish design identity
branding.community_and_virality: Beauty trade outlets (Beauty Independent, BeautyMatter, Global Cosmetic Industry) covered the launch; the company reported 15,000 sign-ups before launch.

brand_strength.rationale: Beauty trade press covered the launch and the founder story gave a distinct angle, but the name is generic (Northwind is also a common software and company name) and no community or merch evidence exists.

outcome_analysis: Northwind launched in the US in October 2022 after YC Winter 2022 with 15,000 sign-ups and about 2 million dollars raised, but the cause of its inactive status is not public. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff report was found, the website now shows only a placeholder, and no later funding round exists in sources, so the failure reason cannot be sourced. The company sold a regulated telehealth and compounded drug product, which adds cost and compliance load, but that is context rather than a stated cause.
notes: Funding sources conflict: Startupintros reports a 2M seed in 2021-12 (VCBacked also 2.0M, labels pre-seed); CB Insights shows 2M seed dated 2022-10; Beauty Independent (Oct 2022) says about 2M raised to date and a seed round expected to close, with YC 500K; BeautyMatter says launched with 1.4M. The 2M seed therefore rests on database reports and may be the cumulative total, not one round. YC 500K is as stated by Beauty Independent. Competitor Curology and brands in the Beauty Independent article are dated Oct 2022, more than a few months after the batch, and are not listed. Company site returned a Hello World placeholder; YC lists the founder as former.
